title: RimWorld mod engineering (RimWorldForge)
why: RimWorldForge indexes installed Core/DLC Defs, generates and validates mod XML, packages builds, and diagnoses Player.log. Its MCP belongs only in a RimWorld mod project; elsewhere the skill remains installed at effectively zero standing context cost.

servers.note: RimWorld 1.6 Def indexing, mod generation, validation, builds and log diagnosis
